title: Blessed In Christ
firstLine: Blessed in Christ, with blessings abundant,

lines: Blessed in Christ, with blessings abundant,
I can thru Him face living each day.
Though pressures mount and stresses surround me,
I go to my father, thru Jesus I pray.
Blessed in Christ, a glorious future,
Now that He cleansed the sins from my past.
Each day I'm rising, nobler I'm living,
Thru grace and mercy He'll save me at last.
Blessed in Christ, with marvelous power!
Daily I live, my Lord to obey.
Power above my asking or thinking
Will cheer my heart and lift me away.
Father I praise Thee for Thy intervention!
Jesus I praise Thee for the redemption!
Spirit I praise Thee for word Inspiration!
Blessed in Christ, all glory to Him.
